title: Modern Question Answering Datasets and Benchmarks: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct its own bias evaluation but surveys QA datasets (like ReClor and CLEVR) that measure and mitigate annotation artifacts/dataset biases. This is evaluated in those datasets by splitting test sets into biased ('EASY') and unbiased ('HARD') subsets, or by using computer-generated 3D shapes to prevent models from cheating via shortcut correlations.
